name: Vehicular Combat
description: The arena racer where the cars are the arsenal: drive, weaponize, ram, and be the last vehicle rolling. This pack reuses the Driving/Racing kit — a combat car is still a tuned car — and adds the vehicle-specific weapon layer: hardpoints and turret arcs on the hull, a speed-times-mass ram model, damage bands that visibly degrade the loser's handling, and arenas that escalate on a script. The design stance: projectiles and hit resolution stay with the generic combat systems; what this pack owns is everything that only makes sense bolted to a chassis.
loop: drive → weaponize → ram/shoot → last vehicle rolling

signatureCompound.name: Last Vehicle Rolling
signatureCompound.description: The arena loop end to end: vehicle_mount_weapons puts arcs and ammo on the hull and hands projectiles to combat.projectile_system, ram_damage_model converts collisions into resolver-routed damage, vehicle_damage_states turns accumulated hits into degraded tuning so every landed shot changes how the target drives, and arena_hazards escalates the floor under everyone until combat.vehicleDisabled leaves exactly one engine running.
